newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain firms arrange $100 mln for Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain firms arrange $100 mln for Pakistan.

text.p: Faysal Islamic Bank of Bahrain and the Islamic Investment Company of the Gulf (IICG) have arranged a $100 million financing facility for Pakistan's Petroleum and Natural Resources Ministry, a statement said.
The statement by the arrangers said the 12-month syndicated financing facility, for the purchase of crude oil and petroleum products, is guaranteed by the State Bank of Pakistan.
It said the agreement was signed in Pakistan on November 19 "and the facility is scheduled to be utilised on November 21."
Bahrain-based IICG is the investment banking arm of the Geneva-based Dar al Mal Al Islamic Group.
